subject: 10 Pounds of Viking Silver Found in Finland Extend Incredible Year for Scandinavian Treasure Hunts
posts:
Unearthing 10 pounds of Viking silver in Finland caps a banner Scandinavian treasure year.
Evidence: Sysmä hoard discovery, 11th century coins, responsible reporting
#Archaeology #History

Metal detectorist Kalle Lappinen uncovered thousands of Viking-era silver coins and artifacts in Finland, marking a historic archaeological find.

Responsible reporting and cooperation with university archaeologists ensured these 11th-century hoards were properly preserved for public study.
